req.title: Create requires title
req.statement: The system shall render 'Title is required.' when POST /create omits the title field.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should render an error message when the title field is omitted in a POST request to /create. This behavior needs to be validated through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_post_with_title
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
r = client.post('/create', data={'title': 'New Post', 'body': 'This is a new post.'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_create_post_without_title
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
r = client.post('/create', data={'body': 'This is a new post without a title.'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Title is required.' in r.data
